name: Openvscode-server
tagline: Provides a version of VS Code that runs a server on a remote machine and allows access through a modern web browser.
description: Openvscode-server provides a version of VS Code that runs a server on a remote machine and allows access through a modern web browser.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/openvscode-server:1.109.5@sha256:3a8bef142c1bd8e6b937ca56b3eb145f22632bd01d4ca0021f37e2e79eb15bb1
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      CONNECTION_TOKEN: ''
      CONNECTION_SECRET: ''
      SUDO_PASSWORD: ''
      SUDO_PASSWORD_HASH: ''
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: /
        target: /casaos
